summary: Parked-up residential kerb in dense unit area; homes all round, but cars park here.

drivers.seclusion: Dense apartments and houses on both sides; nearest east-side dwellings about 24 m, kindergarten 19 m (non-residential).
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parking lane where cars sit; room to pull in beside other cars.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street leading to a corner; modest through traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb, but mixed signs include short-stay limits and no-parking zones, so check on site.

flags: Short-stay and no-stopping signs along stretch
Steep at north end (about 16% max near 0-30 m)
Homes within about 25 m all round
sun_shade: Mostly open to the sky; trees to the east side give some morning shade.
cannot_judge: Exact sign coverage at best section

best_section.where: Mid-block opposite the kindergarten, between the two apartment blocks
